decision.observation: Firing up produced a ring near the top wall (~455,135), roughly 300px above the player, while the chest at (~430,230) remained unchanged — so the ring appears to travel away from the player rather than spawn at a fixed standoff.
decision.hypothesis: The ring passes the chest without damaging it; red-lidded corner chests may be mimic-style and open only after being struck by contact/damage. Alternatively the ring passes over the chest without overlapping. Test close-range fire just below the chest.
decision.memory: Ring travels outward from player (~340px/s), so distance math for standoff is unreliable.
